headline: Health-Tech Customer Success | Physician Onboarding and AI Adoption | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years in client-facing roles at Greenway Health, a US EHR company. I owned onboarding for close to 200 client practices, ran training for 200+ users from physicians to medical assistants, and acted as the voice of the customer, turning pain points into feature requests with product teams. As clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR I mapped physician workflows and scoped AI automation, and I evaluate clinical AI output at Outlier today.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and adoption.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points, business processes and goals, then designed and configured practice-specific workflows and widgets.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on the new workflows.
Wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring client pain points and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: physician onboarding, user adoption, training sessions and walkthroughs, voice of the customer, client relationships
AI scribe and clinical AI workflows, AI output evaluation
clinical workflows, emergency, ICU and inpatient care
thesis_html: Busy doctors need to see in five minutes why a tool is worth it.
why_fit: Close to 200 client practices taken from setup to active use.
Client pain points turned into shipped feature requests.
AI-first EHR clinical lead; clinical AI evaluator at Outlier.
